latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – enables automated generation of in-depth WeChat Official Account articles.

- Gathers topic, audience, style, word count, and special requests before writing.
- Plans and creates full-structure articles (≥1600 words) with introduction, multi-section body, and conclusion.
- Provides 3–5 alternative high-CTR titles for user selection.
- Annotates multimedia (image) placements and handles advertorial and SEO keyword requirements.
- Outputs in a clear, markdown-formatted template with all core information.
- Includes guidance for handling broad topics, advertorials, keywords, and content gaps.
